locations.location: on top of a map of Barcelona

01_Artie_Ficial.text: The moving-picture gallery has a secret on its unseen side.
Success stands on a pedestal. Tonight the prize is underneath the prize.
A lamp dressed in green is illuminating the neighbourhood of a secret.

02_Claire_O_Scuro.text: A life of resistance, written about a German theologian, shelters another secret.
Flowers would call this home; tonight paperwork has moved in.
The cars have an entrance. The secret sits above its door.

03_Hugh_Bidder.text: A seat with a cold metallic skeleton keeps its secret underneath.
A little door hides shelves and, tonight, a secret.
A book beginning with creation has a secret between its pages.

04_Monet_Bags.text: The object that borrows your face has something above its reflection.
The painted world draws your gaze. The clue prefers its hidden reverse.
A soft cushion in the colour of a clear sky conceals something behind it.

05_Chip_Patina.text: Black and white keys make music. Their underside keeps quieter company.
Take a paper journey to the city of Gaudí; your reward rests on its map.
Important information can be found in the coldest room that fits inside a kitchen.

06_Dada_DiCapo.text: Lift your eyes to a trophy, then look where it meets the shelf.
A secret waits behind drapes the colour of spilled wine.
Go where a thousand stories glow; this one waits behind the screen.

07_Vincent_Van_Faux.text: Look inside the vessel that usually gives cut flowers a place to stand.
Find the green light, then examine the space nearby.
Find the biography of the man who chose conscience over obedience. Its pages have company.

08_Sue_Venir.text: Open the cupboard where ordinary things have been given a private gallery.
Look above the large door that admits the household vehicles.
Find a chair that a magnet might fancy. Look beneath its seat.

09_Dr_Art_E_Fact.text: Look behind a painting rather than into its scenery.
The household’s Bible has received a very unofficial insert.
Your reflection cannot look up far enough to see what rests on the mirror.

10_Tess_Tament.text: Spain has a clue for you. Find Barcelona without leaving the house.
The blue cushion is comfortable. Its secret is not meant to stay buried.
A piano’s electric cousin is hiding a note that cannot be played. Look beneath it.

11_Barb_Dwyer.text: The red curtains conceal more than the view beyond the window.
An icy archive is preserving something other than supper.
A champion’s keepsake is concealing something beneath its base.

12_Paige_Turner.text: A green lamp cannot testify, but something near it can.
The house has its own cinema. Inspect the side the audience never sees.
A decorative vessel has traded its bouquet for evidence.

13_Frank_Lloyd_Wrong.text: The garage’s broad doorway has acquired an exhibit overhead. Ask for help reaching it.
A German pastor’s life story has acquired an uninvited appendix.
The household collection behind a cupboard door includes an unexpected exhibit.

14_Mona_Lott.text: From Genesis to Revelation, a familiar book offers room for one extra document.
Not every throne is upholstered; check the underside of a metal one.
The artist signed the front. Somebody else has used the space behind it.

15_Elon_Mosaic.text: Look behind the pillow wearing the colour of the deep sea.
A looking glass shows almost everything. Its upper edge is less forthcoming.
A map of the city beside the Mediterranean carries an extra landmark on top.

16_Anya_Tique.text: The clue has chosen the place where ice cream refuses to melt.
Where fingers conduct a row of musical keys, a clue waits underneath.
Behind a crimson curtain, the museum has misplaced a document.

17_Saul_D_Bid.text: A screen steals every eye. The evidence has slipped out of view behind it.
The award has already been won. Its underside offers another reward.
The clue is keeping company with the lamp in green.

18_Elle_Loominate.text: Dietrich’s story belongs on a bookshelf. Tonight something else belongs between its covers.
No petals are needed: the vase holds a different kind of arrangement.
A clue watches the cars come and go from above the garage door.

19_Reed_DeLabel.text: Four legs and a metallic seat guard a secret from below.
Behind a cupboard’s closed doors, one item has no domestic purpose.
Seek the sacred book with two testaments. Tonight its pages shelter evidence.

20_Al_Baster.text: Find the frame that always contains a portrait of you; check its top.
A wall-hung painting has a backstage area. That is where to investigate.
A blue cushion has been acting as a very quiet accomplice. Check its reverse.

21_Ella_Gance.text: The keyboard has a secret below middle C, but not among the keys.
Follow the streets of Barcelona with your eyes, then inspect what lies over them.
Find the household’s frozen collection. One exhibit is made of paper.

22_Drew_Conclusions.text: The household monument to victory is standing on a secret.
A scarlet stage has a backstage secret. Check behind its fabric.
Televised drama is a distraction. Our drama hides at its back.

23_Brie_DeVivre.text: Find a flower’s borrowed home and inspect its hollow heart.
A shade the colour of leaves marks the place to search beside a lamp.
The life of Bonhoeffer contains more than its author intended.

24_Cary_Crates.text: A cabinet for household supplies has accepted a mysterious new donation.
The highest point of the vehicle entrance conceals some information.
A chair made of metal is sitting on information.

25_Anne_E_Dote.text: The artwork is innocent; something behind it deserves questioning.
A Bible contains a small addition that is not part of scripture.
The mirror has a secret that never appears in its reflection. Look above the glass.

26_Faye_Stop.text: The route to this discovery runs through a map of the Catalan capital.
Something has slipped behind the soft blue square on the seat.
A silent encore waits under the instrument with black and white keys.

27_Robin_Banks.text: Where red drapes close the scene, evidence waits out of sight.
A secret has been put on ice, quite literally.
A trophy is more than decoration tonight. Check below its foot.

28_Penny_Pincher.text: Seek the green lamp; its nearest neighbour is part of this investigation.
Look behind the rectangle that brings distant worlds into the living room.
A vase has swallowed a document. Rescue it without disturbing the china.

29_Justin_Tyme.text: Above the garage door, a document waits for a safe pair of hands.
A biography about costly courage conceals a small piece of tonight’s puzzle.
Look inside a cupboard: the evidence has chosen a room with its own door.

30_Minnie_Malist.text: The clue is inside the book whose final chapter is Revelation.
The hard metal seat has an understudy: a clue waiting underneath.
A picture may be worth a thousand words. There are more words behind this one.
